stem: Which human geographic factor helped the Union win the Civil War?

options.label: F
options.text: A network of railroads in the North allowed Union soldiers to be moved quickly over long distances.

options.label: G
options.text: The Oregon Trail allowed Union military supplies to be moved quickly to the West.

options.label: H
options.text: Northern farms started producing cotton used to make Union military uniforms.

options.label: J
options.text: Canals in the Midwest allowed food for Union soldiers to be moved quickly to the front lines.
